name: Deviant du Chaos
description: Chaos pur désorganisant l'ordre établi des formations adverses rendant la coordination tactique impossible pendant plusieurs cycles.

subject.archetype: Deviant du Chaos — Incursion Dissonante Rare furtif

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes instables entre plusieurs réalités. Membres se dupliquant en images fantômes. Couleurs impossibles. Texture glitch comme un fichier corrompu.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's death ability (enemy_on_capture) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Dynamic action pose mid-ability execution — character actively demonstrating their specialty skill — Vengeful curse energy binding to the enemy who captured this card

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Void Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — gaps where reality is missing

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic rim lighting separating character from background with a focal glow on the primary ability effect

camera.angle: low dramatic angle emphasizing power and heroic stature

scenography.setting: Space where multiple realities overlap, buildings from different dimensions coexisting, sky showing conflicting celestial bodies and impossible colors
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Chromatic aberration splitting colors, spatial tears showing parallel dimensions, partial phasing between states, glitch artifacts and digital corruption, plus posthumous revenge — dark energy crawling up the captor's position after capture visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Chaos pur désorganisant l'ordre établi des formations adverses rendant la coordination tactique impossible pendant plusieurs cycles.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Incursion Dissonante est l'ouverture de fissures entre les réalités, laissant passer des entités impossibles. Leur présence corrompt la structure même du réel.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols deeply engraved on each corner of the border
card_metadata.composition_directive: Low angle heroic full-body shot emphasizing power, with ability visualization clearly shown in action
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
